title: NetHack
description: Procedurally generated, permadeath and very long. Ascension is an unambiguous clear. BALROG tracks partial progress for zero-shot LLMs.
clear_condition: Ascend: offer the Amulet of Yendor at your god's high altar on the Astral Plane.
rules: NetHack 3.6 or 3.7 (state it), any role. Public servers with dumplogs (e.g. Hardfought) count as evidence alongside video. Disclose wiki/spoiler access. Milestones need not be reached in order.
timing: Elapsed real time where known; report game turns in notes.

attempts.name: BALROG
attempts.team_zh: 伦敦大学学院 AI 中心等（ICLR 2025）
attempts.result: LLM agents play NetHack as text, zero-shot. Progress is scored as the chance that a human who reached the same dungeon or experience level went on to win. The leaderboard's best is GPT-6 Astra Max at 13.2% average progression; when the paper came out the best was o1-preview at about 1.5%.
attempts.result_zh: LLM 智能体以文本形式零样本玩 NetHack。进度的算法是：到达同样地牢层数或经验等级的人类玩家最终获胜的概率。排行榜上最好的是 GPT-6 Astra Max，平均进度 13.2%；论文发表时最好的是 o1-preview，约 1.5%。
attempts.why_not: An average over runs on a probability scale, not the milestones of a single run.
attempts.why_not_zh: 这是多局在一个概率刻度上的平均值，不是单局达成的里程碑。

attempts.name: NetHack Challenge (NeurIPS 2021)
attempts.team: Competition on the NetHack Learning Environment
attempts.team_zh: 基于 NetHack 学习环境的比赛
attempts.result: The winner, the rule-based bot AutoAscend, had a median score of about 5,300, and the best rule-based entries scored nearly three times the best neural ones. In over half a million evaluation games, no agent ascended.
attempts.result_zh: 冠军是基于规则的机器人 AutoAscend，得分中位数约 5,300；最好的规则型参赛作品得分接近最好的神经网络作品的三倍。在超过 50 万局评测中，没有任何智能体飞升。
attempts.why_not: Scores are summarized over many games; no individual game has been submitted with its recording.
attempts.why_not_zh: 成绩是对大量对局的汇总，没有提交任何一局的录像。
